selection.matched_pairs: For each direction select the query nearest the pooled median and 90th percentile of best scores; exact ties by source fit, target fit, topic. Show the median neural-to-Tomotopy pair and 90th-percentile pair as illustrative spectra, not representative chemical validations
selection.multiplicity: Select the neural-to-Tomotopy query nearest the pooled 90th percentile of second-best scores, and its two best targets; inspect actual spectral features instead of selecting an arbitrary high-overlap cutoff
selection.spectra: Top 20 words per topic, retaining typed mass, unrenormalized beta probability, support and MAG availability. Display probabilities relative to each topic's maximum, never as experimental ion intensities
